nodes.rationale: Proof-of-work limit is used to reset difficulty for the new algorithm and for Segwit/CSV activation.

nodes.label: Legacy Bitcoin Retarget Below Height 29000 (14 days / 10 minutes)
LWMA Zero Target Known Limit
nodes.rationale: Integer division of target/(k*N), k*N about 8.3e8, gives 0 only if every target in the window is below that; unreachable since powLimit is about 2^224. Left unguarded on purpose because a guard would change consensus and need a fork; the pow fuzz target keeps targets above powLimit >> 100; a future algorithm change should round up or use a minimum target.

nodes.label: Pre-Fork OP_RETURN Size Limit 83 Bytes (bad-txns-oversize-opreturn-prefork)
nodes.rationale: Relay policy check in mempool acceptance while the next block is below nResilienceForkHeight; not a block validity rule.

nodes.label: Taproot Hardcoded Height Activation
nodes.rationale: Since v2.0.3 Taproot is enforced from a hardcoded block height, not BIP9 state, because miner signaling on BIP9 bit 2 activated it at height 385200 before the implementation was deployed and split the chain.

nodes.label: Taproot BIP9 Deployment Bit 2 (signaling only)
nodes.rationale: Still defined (start 1771027200, timeout 1803859200) only so miners keep signaling; it does not decide when the rules apply. getblockchaininfo reports Taproot as a buried softfork.

nodes.label: BIP9 Taproot Chain Split at Height 385200 (nodes stuck at 385246)
nodes.rationale: v2.0.0 used BIP9 with 75% threshold (540 of 720 blocks); miners signaling activated it at 385200 before deployment; v2.0.3 fixed it with height 405000 and accepts earlier blocks without Taproot rules.

nodes.label: Testnet Header nBits Always Compared with Expected Value (2.1.0)
nodes.rationale: ContextualCheckBlockHeader skipped the nBits comparison for blocks more than 4 minutes after their parent, so such a block could claim any difficulty; the 20 minute minimum difficulty rule is already inside GetNextWorkRequired.

nodes.label: Pre-Fork OP_RETURN Limit Checked Against Height()+1 (2.1.0)
nodes.rationale: A transaction accepted just before the fork height must not fail in the first block of the fork; relay policy, not consensus.
